**Chinese name:** 深圳市汇顶科技股份有限公司 (Shēnzhèn Shì Huìdǐng Kējì Gǔfèn Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded 2002 in Shenzhen; once called China's 'fingerprint chip king,' a major global supplier of fingerprint and touch sensor ICs to smartphone makers. FY2025 revenue was ¥4.74 billion (+8.2%) and net profit ¥837 million (+38.7%), helped by ultrasonic fingerprint sensors in commercial use since Q4 2024. H1 2026 reversed: revenue ¥2.06 billion (−8.4%) and net profit ¥252 million (−41.6%). Its 'fingerprint chip king' standing dates from its 2017 market lead.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Fingerprint sensors (ultrasonic, optical in-display, and capacitive) and touch/display-integrated sensor ICs.
